scope: Full hospitality revision based on Hotel Vagmi's guest journey, with Augusto's own factual content, photographs and visual identity.
features: Three-scene property hero with pause and manual controls
Date, party and room enquiry bars
All three rooms visible on the homepage
Dedicated room walkthroughs and accessible photo viewers
Room comparison, including a separate mobile layout
Vegetarian dining and contextual meal enquiries
Attributed guest-review excerpt and independent review links
Arrival modes, copyable address, opt-in map and directions
WhatsApp enquiry handoff with validation and editable draft
